title: MIA-aware FinFlex Cell Legalization with Power-Driven Cell Version Substitution
problem: Standard cell legalization and placement optimization for TSMC FinFlex technology in sub-3nm nodes, accounting for multiple cell versions with varying heights and threshold voltages while respecting minimum implant area (MIA) constraints.
motivation: FinFlex cells provide design flexibility but complicate placement optimization due to version diversity; efficient cell substitution can improve power efficiency and area utilization in advanced nodes.
method: Three-stage algorithm: (1) intra-row violation-aware preprocessing considering timing and power; (2) directed acyclic graph (DAG) based initial legalization with cell version substitution; (3) dynamic programming-based inter-row violation removal to handle MIA constraint violations.
key_novelty: First systematic approach to FinFlex cell legalization incorporating power-driven version substitution and MIA constraint handling via DAG-based and dynamic programming stages.
contributions: First legalization algorithm for FinFlex technology addressing version substitution and MIA constraints
Multi-stage approach combining DAG-based legalization with dynamic programming for violation removal
Power efficiency optimization through intelligent cell version selection
